# Boots Hearingcare

> Boots Hearingcare provides comprehensive hearing solutions including free hearing tests, audiologist services, hearing aids from leading brands (Phonak, Starkey, AudioNova, Widex), and professional ear care services across the UK.

Boots Hearingcare is the hearing care division of Boots UK, offering both in-store and online hearing assessment tools, a range of hearing aid products at multiple price tiers, and dedicated aftercare support. The service combines NHS options with premium private hearing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Free hearing test
- Hearing aids
- Audiologist services
- Phonak hearing aids
- Starkey hearing aids
- AudioNova hearing aids
- Invisible hearing aids (IIC)
- Hearing loss solutions
- Earwax removal
- Hearing aid accessories
- Aftercare support
- NHS vs private hearing aids
- Hearing aid prices
- Bluetooth connectivity
- Hearing health information
